key_insight: DistDNA identifies LLM checkpoints under stochastic decoding by comparing response distributions rather than individual responses, without training an identity classifier.
engineering_relevance: It supports verification that a deployed LLM matches its claimed checkpoint despite unknown temperature and top-p settings.
method: Sample multiple responses to shared prompts to estimate prompt-conditional response distributions.
Compare fingerprints using promptwise maximum mean discrepancy (MMD).
Assign the nearest known checkpoint using reference fingerprints collected at several decoding settings.
evidence_signal: Across 115 model checkpoint entries, DistDNA improved identification accuracy over the strongest baseline, LLM DNA, by a reported 10.36%.
watch_item: Finite sampling adds variance-dependent distance terms that decrease as O(1/R), so reliable identification must balance responses per prompt against collection cost.
paper_title: DistDNA: Language Model Fingerprinting under Stochastic Decoding
